title: Chapter 626
text:
Han Xiao was not interested in the first option, [Magnetic Field Vision]. He currently had close to a thousand points of Machinery Affinity, and this bonus was negligible.

Of the three abilities, [Strong Magnetic Field Shield] was without a doubt the most powerful. If it was given to the players, it could be considered half a godly ability. The downside was that it consumed a lot of energy, but to Han Xiao, it was still bearable.

Unfortunately, he did not really want another tank ability. He was already extremely tanky, and if he continued to be tanky, he would become a deity. [Strong Magnetic Field Shield] conflicted with the conversion of energy and health. Only when his body took damage would it be absorbed and converted into energy, but it would not work on the shield.

Although this ability was not bad, he did not really need it.

The other two abilities had slightly chuunibyou names, but their effects were not bad. They could be used as offensive means when he was not using machinery. However, he did not use machinery very often, so he would not use them very often.

The last talent was [Super Electromagnetic Induction]. The introduction was very simple, but Han Xiao had seen similar talents in his previous life. It strengthened the basic attributes of energy, and the value of energy bonus would increase tremendously. This kind of talent was relatively rare. Not only the Mechanic class, but the other four classes also had talents that strengthened the energy attribute. Shana's Esper Ability just happened to be compatible with the Mechanic class.

The magnetic attribute was related to Mechanical Force. If he chose this, his Machinery Affinity would increase tremendously, at least a few times more than the first talent. Furthermore, when he obtained a new layer of energy bonus in the future, this talent would still be effective, which was equivalent to increasing his growth potential.

This could be considered a rare high-level Mechanic talent with growth potential.

"Tsk, I can only choose one. I really want all of them …"

Han Xiao scratched his head in frustration. Other than the first option, he wanted all four.

After much consideration, he made the choice because he valued long-term potential more.

You have received [Super Electromagnetic Induction]!

Your magnetic attribute energy has been strengthened!

Your energy bonus has changed!

Han Xiao opened his personal attributes, glanced at it, and smiled.

With every layer of energy bonus, his Machinery Affinity increased significantly. Currently, he was at [LV11] Energy Realm. Originally, it increased his Machinery Affinity by 142%, but with this talent, it increased to 262%!

It increased his Machinery Affinity by 120%!

It almost doubled!

"It's done. We won't lose anything this time."

Han Xiao was quite satisfied. The additional 120% Affinity directly increased his Mechanical Force bonus by more than a thousand. This talent still had a long term potential to be unearthed, and it would only become stronger as he leveled up.

Although it could not be compared to Reynold's cheat-like [Perfect Mechanical Sense], it was still not bad. Together with his own [Basic Mechanical Sense], he finally had two Mechanic talents.

"That's more like a Mechanic."

Han Xiao chuckled.

However, the other three skills were also quite good. He felt a little regretful that he couldn't choose all of them.

"This is only the first round of the mission. Shana is still alive. If every round's reward is a draw ability …"

Han Xiao's eyes lit up, and he could not help but fantasize. He suddenly felt moved, and he wished he could meet Shana a few more times.

Shana was a treasure trove of skills!

He glanced at the second round of the [Prey] mission. It hadn't refreshed yet.

The second round of the mission would probably only appear when the enemy attacked again.

"The enemy is in the dark, and I'm in the light. Luckily, I planted an eye on her, or I wouldn't have been able to defend against their surprise attack. Just like the name of the mission, they're hunters waiting for an opportunity to strike, and I'm the prey. If I were to be attacked at a crucial moment in other missions, the losses would be huge. These hunters are really troublemakers."

Han Xiao secretly rejoiced.

On the way back, Han Xiao heard the conversation between Shana and Eliot through the Observer's Mark. He knew that Lu Ren was heading toward the headquarters.

If he could confirm the location of this mysterious organization's headquarters, he might be able to drag Ames up to the high ground.

With Floating Dragon smashing down, not to mention crystals, the enemy's spring water might not even exist …

Patience was the basic quality of a peeping tom. There was no point in being impatient. He would only gain something from the Observer's Mark after some time.

Han Xiao went to the training room to test out his new talent. He then taught Sylvia and Reynold a lesson before letting Sylvia report on the matters of the army. After dealing with the trivial matters, he went into the machinery modification room and started his seclusion.

Shana's attack had given him some pressure. If her companions all had Grade A + strength, they would be an unprecedentedly strong opponent. Han Xiao was prepared to go into seclusion to build a batch of non-metallic machinery as well as a magnetic field reversal device that could neutralize Shana's magnetic field manipulation Esper Ability.

With plenty of EXP, Han Xiao did not care about the expenses. He gambled a large number of blueprints and found quite a number of useful blueprints.

Including the blueprints, the number of his skills had already exceeded a thousand. The effect of the [Research Theory] talent had already accumulated more than three hundred Intelligence points.

Building non-metallic machinery was one aspect of increasing his strength. On the other hand, Han Xiao felt that it was time to increase his level.

Currently, he was level 170 and stuck at the [Galaxy Mechanic] Class Advancement mission. If he completed the Class Advancement, his strength would increase greatly, and he would be able to obtain the next important Mechanic skills.

The Class Advancement requirement was very straightforward. He only needed to learn one Cutting-Edge Knowledge.

However, it was not easy for Han Xiao.

In his previous life, when the players were at this level, the version was already quite late. After playing for a long time and experiencing many main storylines, they had already built relationships with many factions and could directly exchange for Cutting-Edge Knowledge.

However, Han Xiao was too advanced. Due to the version limitation, he did not have the chance to build relationships with the Star Cluster Civilizations. Therefore, this simple Class Advancement requirement in his previous life blocked him.

It was not difficult, but it was very difficult.

Han Xiao had already used up all the Random Rewards that he had accumulated. He inherited the Black Face Chief's bloodline and did not get a Mission Completion Card.

The Mission Completion Card was actually very cheap. It was not a rare item. The things that he had drawn were basically worth more than the Mission Completion Card. For example, he had drawn the precious Esper Ability Potential Enhancing Fluid twice in a row. Including the one he had accumulated a long time ago, he now had three.

He felt that it was a waste of time for him to draw a Mission Completion Card after touching Fu Ding.

Cutting-Edge Knowledge was a must to learn, so Han Xiao was too lazy to gamble on the Mission Completion Card. He only hoped that the Amethyst Civilization would quickly build Section Zero. He did not say anything and just started farming. In [Crimson Tide], there was no lack of faction missions.

…

In the outer space orbit of the Amethyst Civilization's mother planet, a garrison satellite station codenamed 'Scimitar' surrounded the mother planet. This was a newly built space station, and it was the office of a new organization. The members of this organization were all elites drawn from the various departments of the Secret Service Agency.

At this moment, inside the Scimitar garrison satellite station, in the office of the highest-ranking officer, a group of Foreign Affairs Captains sat up straight and stared at the highest-ranking officer of this organization, Ralph.

Ralph flipped through the work reports of everyone and listened to the captains explain the situation.

"The list of cooperating organizations has been sorted out. A total of 173 new organizations have been selected. We have contacted all of them, and they all have the intention of cooperating with us. Please take a look."

"The number is too small."

Ralph's tone was calm. In front of his subordinates, he was very dignified.

"In terms of the size of the entire Star Cluster, the number is indeed small. However, the 173 candidate organizations were the result of our careful selection. All of them have a Calamity Grade Super in their organization. This is a mandatory requirement. They are distributed in the various Star Systems of Colton and have a very high status and reputation."

"For example?"

"Seyfuli's Arc Light Organization, Skywalker's Hero Group, Ryan's New Phylen Militia … These few organizations are the most powerful among the candidates."

"It's still not enough. The strength of these non-official armed organizations is far from the combined forces of the Klents."

Ralph shook his head with dissatisfaction. "The development of Colton's private organizations is too chaotic and scattered. Klent has the Bloodshed Land, and one of them is comparable to all of our cooperating organizations. Klent has helped their ally, the Bloodshed Land, expand in the past two years and integrated about half of the private organizations in their territory. Klent wants to form a combined force with the Bloodshed Land as the core. Facing such a colossus, the cooperating organizations we found are completely powerless. If they want to start a secret war, we have no chance of winning."

"Indeed, the enemy has the Bloodshed Land. If we don't mobilize the official army, no one will be able to stop the Tyrant. However, Beyond Grade A Supers will not make a move easily. They represent deterrence. It's not like we don't have Beyond Grade As in Colton. The Dragon Emperor is also here."

"However, the Dragon Emperor Ames is neutral. She's not our ally." Ralph frowned.

"The Black Star Corps is on the list of cooperating organizations. Although they can't be compared to our old partners and the strongest candidates mentioned earlier, their strength can still be ranked in the second tier of the list. Their background is the Floating Dragon Armed Forces. Maybe we can make use of the Dragon Emperor's strength through them."

"I know Black Star. He's a very smart guy. Don't think about using him to get close to Ames … Besides, Ames might not be a match for the Tyrant Heber." Ralph shook his head.

After pausing for a while, he continued to remind his subordinate. "Currently, Klent is still holding back, but they will become more and more rampant in the future. Sooner or later, they will start a secret war. The higher-ups have already spoken. We can't let the enemy force out the official army, or else a war might really break out. Klent wants to snatch part of Colton's territory. Even if the three Universal Civilizations come to stop the war, the Red Empire is Klent's backer, and we will be at a disadvantage politically. We might be forced to sign an unfair treaty … I'm not satisfied with the current list. The purpose of our organization is to deal with Klent's expansion. You have to rope in more armed organizations."

"Understood!"

"Also, the approval from the higher-ups has been issued. The organization has an official code name. When the time comes, inform the candidates. This will be the name of the organization formed by all the cooperating organizations."

"What's the code name?"

Ralph tapped the table with his finger and said with a serious tone, "Secret Service, Section Zero!"
